Name: Kin the Axolotl NPC
Author: otohimexoxo
Description:
my first NPC mod! i put a lot of love into it, so i hope you enjoy~

[b][size=3][u]Sequel to this mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20431]Axolotl Village[/url][/u][/size][/b][size=3][b][u]
[/u][/b][/size](note that Axolotl Village spoils the story of this mod if you don't finish all of the events for Kin first!)

. ☆  . • ☆ . ° .• °:. *₊ ° . ☆

[img]https://imgur.com/V93CvTp.png[/img]
﻿1. download and install all other required mods
2. download this mod
3. unzip folder into stardew's mod folder

[img]https://imgur.com/nA1APYR.png[/img]
♡ all sprites made by me


[b][u][size=4]Kin's Loves/Likes/Dislikes/Hates/Neutrals:
[/size][/u][/b][spoiler]♡ [b]Loves: [/b]All gold items
♡ [b]Likes[/b][b]: [/b]All iron items
♡ [b]Dislikes:[/b] All copper items
♡ [b]Hates:[/b] All iridium items
♡ [b]Neutrals: [/b]All minerals[/spoiler]

[b][u][size=4]All Events
[/size][/u][/b][spoiler]♡ [b]Meeting Kin[/b][b]:[/b] Anytime from 6 AM to 8 PM - Secret Woods
♡ [b]Meeting Kin Part 2: [/b]Anytime from 6 AM to 8 PM - Secret Woods - Must have at least one heart
♡ [b]Bringing Tails to Kin[/b][b]: [/b]Anytime from 6 AM to 8 PM - Secret Woods - Must have all 6 colors of axolotl tails (albino, pink, blue, yellow, purple and black) in inventory. Must have the Axolotl Barn Animals mod in order to receive the tails
♡ [b]Four Heart Event:[/b] Anytime from 6 AM to 8 PM - Secret Woods
♡ [b]Six Heart Event:[/b] Anytime from 6 AM to 8 PM - Farm
♡ [b]Eight Heart Event[/b][b]: [/b]Anytime from 6 AM to 8 PM - Secret Woods
♡ [b]Ten Heart Event[/b][b]: [/b]Anytime from 8 PM to 11 PM - Forest[/spoiler]
